<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/transfers/{transferLineId}/stow"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Places a STAGED transfer receipt's goods into destination-site bins (ADR 0031) — the ONLY path that raises the destination site's usable stock for a transfer, exactly once per transfer_line_id. Every requested bin must be registered at the receipt's destination site (the site-custody fact fails closed: another site's bin or a legacy site-less bin is a 409), and the bin quantities must sum EXACTLY to the receipt's receivedQuantity. One StockUnit per bin leg is created AT the destination site, the receipt moves STAGED -&gt; STOWED, and TransferStockStowed is published through the same transactional outbox.

Idempotent at the database level: a replayed stow for an already-STOWED receipt answers 200 with the ORIGINAL outcome (replay: true, the original allocations), creates NO second StockUnit and publishes nothing new. Stowing a line with no staged receipt (stow-before-stage) is a 409 receipt-not-staged.
